subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving rational numbers, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student works through a realistic multi-step scenario (temperature change, financial gain/loss) using rational number operations
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a model or number-line representation of the multi-step problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a multi-step rational number word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: solves only part of a multi-step problem or applies operations in the wrong order relative to the problem's context

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
